instruction: Look at the paper open on the Desktop and find where the corresponding author works. Then open Chrome and navigate to that institution's official website.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-40)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly reads Chrome's active tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the appropriate state to verify navigation to the institution's website.

Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly handles the 'rule' type expected parameter: accesses rules['expected'] = ['stanford\\.edu'] directly, which is correct since the framework passes config['rules'] as the rules parameter.

Expected pattern 'stanford\\.edu' is semantically correct: the paper footnote confirms the corresponding author (Tianlin Tim Shi) is from Stanford University (email tianlin@cs.stanford.edu), so stanford.edu is the right institution URL.
Pattern is appropriately flexible — matches any stanford.edu subdomain (www.stanford.edu, cs.stanford.edu, etc.) consistent with the task description that 'any stanford.edu page passes'.
Negative control resistance is adequate: initial state (PDF viewer open, Chrome not open) would cause getter to return None/fail, yielding score 0.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: could add 'www\\.stanford\\.edu' as an alternative expected pattern to be more explicit, though the current broad pattern is intentional and acceptable.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully identified the corresponding author (Tianlin Tim Shi, Stanford University) from the PDF footnote 'Correspondence to: Tianlin (Tim) Shi <tianlin@cs.stanford.edu>' at step 5. Failed to complete Google Scholar navigation.
metadata.capability_extraction: Agent demonstrated reading PDF footnotes to identify affiliation information (steps 2-5 reliable prefix: scroll and read). Also shown ability to open Chrome and navigate to URLs.
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent failed when switching from PDF viewer to Chrome browser at step 7. The core PDF-reading capability (identifying corresponding author and affiliation Stanford University) was successfully demonstrated.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposes the original task into: (1) read PDF footnote to find corresponding author's affiliation (Stanford University), (2) navigate Chrome to stanford.edu. Both steps are within demonstrated capabilities. Much simpler than finding a specific Google Scholar profile.
metadata.explanation: Task requires reading the PDF to find the corresponding author's affiliation (Tianlin Tim Shi at Stanford University, per paper footnote '¹Stanford University, Stanford, USA.
